```{r}
library(swemaps2)
library(stringr)

df <- source("fetch_and_tidy_lan_data_api.R", local = TRUE)$value
```

```{r}
df <-
    df %>%
    rename(län = region) %>% 
    full_join(swemaps2::county %>%
                    mutate(län = ln_namn %>% str_c(" län"),
               .keep = 'unused'))
```

```{r}
df %>% 
    ggplot(aes(fill=median_price, geometry = geometry)) +
        geom_sf() +
        scale_fill_viridis_c() +
        theme_swemap2()
```
